long_title: AN ACT TO PROVIDE A LEGAL FRAMEWORK FOR THE PROTECTION OF PERSONAL INFORMATION, AND ESTABLISH THE NIGERIA DATA PROTECTION COMMISSION FOR THE REGULATION OF THE PROCESSING OF PERSONAL INFORMATION; AND FOR RELATED MATTERS
enacting_formula: ENACTED by the National Assembly of the Federal Republic of Nigeria—
gazette: Federal Republic of Nigeria Official Gazette No. 119, Lagos - 1st July, 2023, Vol. 110, Government Notice No. 82
assented_by: BOLA AHMED TINUBU, GCFR, President of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, 12th Day of June, 2023
explanatory_memorandum: This Act provides a legal framework for the protection of personal information and establishes the Nigeria Data Protection Commission for the regulation of the processing of personal information.
source_document: Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023 (Act No. 37), Federal Republic of Nigeria Official Gazette No. 119, Vol. 110, 1 July 2023 (KB 2/Africa/Nigeria_Data_Protection_Act_2023.pdf)
